empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create reusable review guidance, or import Markdown from pasted text or a local file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to configure it, preview the Markdown, or inspect its versions.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Skills are reusable text configuration shared by review agents.
create.starterBody:
# {name}

Describe what the reviewer should check and when this guidance applies.
create.createFailed: The skill could not be created. Review the fields and try again.
create.bodyHint: Markdown sent to every agent that links this skill.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: Paste Markdown or load a local text file, then review it before enabling it.
drawer.localOnly: Only local text is read. URL imports and the community catalog are not connected in this version, and imported skills start disabled.

import.fileHint: .md, .markdown, or .txt. The file is read in your browser and is not executed.
import.nameHint: Optional when the Markdown starts with a level-one heading.
import.bodyHint: Review this text carefully: an attached, enabled skill becomes part of an agent's instructions.
import.bodyPlaceholder:
# Review rule

Explain what to check…
import.readFailed: The selected file could not be read.
import.createFailed: The skill could not be imported. Review the fields and try again.

community.unavailable: Community search is unavailable because no catalog service is configured.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain when this skill should be attached

config.title: Configuration
config.bodyHint: This is the only skill text sent to an agent. Saving a changed body creates an immutable version.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It will be removed from every agent that uses it.
config.mutationFailed: The skill change could not be saved. Try again.

preview.title: Markdown preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

evals.title: Evals are not available yet
evals.body: This tab is a deliberate scaffold. No eval cases are created or scored by the current Skills API.

stats.title: Skill statistics are not available yet
stats.body: DevDigest does not yet attribute findings or review outcomes to individual skills, so no usage metrics are shown here.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every saved configuration snapshot keeps the exact body used by that version.
versions.emptyBody: A version will appear after the skill is saved.
versions.diffTitle: Changes from v{version} to the current v{current}
versions.diffLegend: − only in v{version} · + only in the current body
versions.diffSame: This version’s body is identical to the current body.
versions.restoreBody: The body of v{version} becomes a new version, v{next}. The history is kept: no version is changed or removed. Name, description and type stay as they are.
versions.restoreFailed: Could not restore this version. Try again.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.failed: The skill could not be deleted. Try again.
delete.impactLoading: Checking which agents use this skill…
delete.impactFailed: Could not check which agents use this skill, so it cannot be deleted yet.

statusTooltip.approved: A workspace owner approved this exact content (v{version}) to enter the review's system message.
statusTooltip.unapproved: No workspace owner has approved this content. While it is enabled on an agent, that agent's reviews are blocked.
statusTooltip.stale: The content changed after v{approved} was approved. Reviews that use it are blocked until the current version is approved.
statusTooltip.revoked: The approval was revoked. Reviews that use this skill are blocked until it is approved again.

approval.title: System-prompt approval
approval.explainer: Enabled and approved are separate. Enabled decides whether agents use the skill; approved means a workspace owner reviewed this exact text for the review's system message. An enabled skill that is not approved blocks every review that would use it.
approval.approveTitle: Approve v{version} for the system prompt?
approval.approveBody: You are approving exactly the raw text below (v{version}). It will be placed in the review's system message for every agent that has this skill enabled. Any later edit or restore requires a new approval.
approval.revokeBody: Reviews by agents that have this skill enabled will be blocked until it is approved again.
approval.conflict: The skill changed since this page loaded. Review the current content and approve again.
approval.forbidden: Only a workspace owner can approve or revoke skill content.
approval.failed: Could not save the decision. Try again.
approval.historyError: Could not load the approval history.
approval.rawHint: The stored text as the model receives it, unrendered. Comments, raw HTML and link definitions that the preview above hides are shown here; review this, not the preview.
approval.rawConfirmTitle: Exact text of v{version} to approve
